Wellness 360 Physical Therapy & Massage Therapy is a Webster, New York business giving life-long wellness support for people with specific disease diagnosis. We support our patients with Physical Therapy, Massage Therapy, Wellness services and Group Fitness classes to manage, reverse, and prevent disease diagnosis. We specialize in the treatment of patients with Parkinson’s, Osteoporosis, Osteoarthritis, Low Back Pain, Pre and Postnatal and Balance issues. Our programs are a cost-effective way to treat and manage your disease diagnoses. We believe exercise, when done correctly is medicine. All classes are designed and instructed by a licensed physical therapist, trained to provide a safe and effective class based on your diagnosis and fitness level.

961 Panorama Trail, S, Ste 2, Rochester, NY
585-482-5060
